test_title: PYST 43 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: In a certain coded language 'KOOK' is coded as 'OSSO' and 'FRIG' is coded as 'JVMK'. How will 'ORBS' be coded in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d41bb8f68ec4f7e86222eb4ba92485bd7edac63f342f792dc4cdf11a9409f8f.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘KOOK’ is written as OSSO,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f81fa70da73a550f59745109d215888c16b2b080619d541bae08c2618bd8020.png] 

For, ‘FRIG’ is written as JVMK,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c243d4b624d1909cbec548f78009f2bb6d7634de5cfbbc46645382e37b8139b1.png] 

Similarly, for ‘ORBS’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fface0c393a99d5a7a2e3680d40cd5d51e0a6d2214a4add53e03fd14b4f0104.png] 

So, ‘ORBS’ will be written as ‘SVFW’.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
